CAT-HUNTER-SUB5.name: Under-5 primary-source catalyst hunter (FDA designation or positive topline 8-K), clean supply, hold 10 / stop 25%
CAT-HUNTER-SUB5.rule: Raw close 1-5 USD on the signal session t, 20-day average traded value >= 1M USD. Signal: an 8-K public in session t whose text contains an FDA designation phrase (Breakthrough Device/Therapy, Fast Track, Orphan Drug, Rare Pediatric Disease designation) [type A], or a positive-topline / primary-endpoint-met phrase in an 8-K carrying item 8.01 or 2.02 [type C]. Exclude: reverse split in the 60 days before t; 424B5 / S-1 / S-1/A / S-3 / S-3/A public in sessions t-19..t; any close-to-close move of 15%+ (either way) in t-21..t-1; already up 40%+ on the prior close when public (open for a pre-open filing, close for a filing in the session). Buy t+1 open; sell at the close of session 10 (entry day = 1) or a 25% stop under the fill.
CAT-HUNTER-SUB5.why: loses after 2% slippage each way in the older half; loses after 3% each way in the older half; not better than the average stock of its band in the older half; not better than the same stocks on their other days in the older half; loses without its 2 best in the older half; block t -1.9859 under 2.5 in the older half; loses after 2% slippage each way in the newer half; loses after 3% each way in the newer half; not better than the average stock of its band in the newer half; not better than the same stocks on their other days in the newer half; loses without its 2 best in the newer half; block t -1.0433 under 2.5 in the newer half

UNDER5-JUMP.name: Crashed and stabilising under-5 stock that jumps on 3x volume with a fresh reason, clean supply (sell half at +20%, rest by day 3)
UNDER5-JUMP.rule: Raw close 0.50-5 USD, 20-day average traded value >= 0.5M USD. At t-1: close <= 60% of its 200-day average and within 2% of the lowest close of 252 sessions. Lowest low of t-9..t >= lowest low of t-29..t-10; high-low range of t-9..t <= 0.6x that of t-29..t-10; average volume of t-9..t >= 1.2x that of t-29..t-10. Day t: volume >= 3x its 50-session average, close in the top 25% of the day range, close +15% on the prior close, or +4% with a fresh reason (see deviations). Share count up < 5% over 90 days; no 424B5 / S-1 / S-1/A / 8-K item 3.02 public in t-19..t; no close-to-close rise of 15%+ in t-21..t-1. Buy t+1 open (skip if it opens at or under the day-t low); stop = day-t low; at the first close 20%+ over the fill sell half at that close and move the stop to the fill; sell the rest at the next open after a close under the 10-day average, else at the close of session 3.
UNDER5-JUMP.why: older 0 trades / 0 blocks; newer 0 trades / 0 blocks

UNDER5-REVERSE.name: Down 70%+ since a recent reverse split, no new low for 10 sessions, 2x volume and a fresh 8-K 1.01 (hold 10)
UNDER5-REVERSE.rule: Raw close 0.50-5 USD, 20-day average traded value >= 0.5M USD. A reverse split executed in sessions t-62..t-10; close t <= 30% of the first post-split close; the lowest low since the split was set before t-9 (no lower low in t-9..t); volume t >= 2x its 50-session average; an 8-K with item 1.01 public in t-9..t. Buy t+1 open (skip if at or under the day-t low); stop = day-t low; sell at the close of session 10.
UNDER5-REVERSE.why: older 2 trades / 2 blocks; newer 1 trades / 1 blocks

UNDER5-EPS-LOW.name: Under-5 earnings gap-up of 5%+, then 3 quiet days holding above the gap midpoint (buy day 4, hold 10)
UNDER5-EPS-LOW.rule: Gap session g: an 8-K with item 2.02 public before the open of g; raw prior close 0.50-5 USD; 20-day average traded value >= 0.5M USD; open g >= 1.05x the prior close. Midpoint = (prior close + open g) / 2. Sessions g+1..g+3 each: low above the midpoint and volume under the gap day volume. Buy the open of g+4 (skip if at or under the midpoint); stop = midpoint; sell at the close of session 10.
